set.body:
Requested by a downstream desktop host (eyes4s Studio), stated generically.

Problem
Lines drawn over arbitrary imagery (contours over photographs, trajectories over maps or images) are illegible where the stroke colour meets similar backgrounds. Cartographic practice is a cased stroke: a wider underlay (e.g. white at partial alpha) beneath the main stroke. Today a caller must duplicate the layer, which doubles picking targets and legend keys.

Scope
An optional casing on GraphicParams (or on the line/path/contour geoms): casing colour, casing width (absolute or relative to stroke width) and casing alpha, drawn immediately beneath the stroke of the same primitive on every backend, excluded from picking and from legend keys (or drawn in the key when requested).

Acceptance criteria
1. Rendered order per primitive is casing then stroke, on SVG, PDF, Java2D, Canvas and JavaFX (conformance scene).
2. Picking hits and legend entries are unchanged by casing.
3. Dash patterns apply to the stroke; the casing is solid unless configured.
4. Works for geomLine, geomSegment and geomContour; documented with an image-background example.
5. A visual-regression fixture shows the cased line legible on both light and dark backgrounds.
set.title: [Intaglio] Stroke casing: an optional contrasting underlay stroke for lines, paths and contours
